Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Darrell Yates Rist, and Jim Levin, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 2. Short news stories 3. Discussion of the Center for Disease Control Conference in Atlanta, and the growing nuance in AIDS discussion COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation 4. Discussion of the radical Lavender Hill Mob movement and its public disturbance as a protest method COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 5. Andy Humm on the conflict between organized religion and homosexuality 6. News Watch, Delaware State Insurance Commission approves gay-sensitive health insurance guidelines 7. Chicago, "gay dollar" stamps now sold by mail 8. National Gay Rights Advocates publish a tax guide for gay and lesbian men and women 9. California's State Association of Health calls for the isolated quarantining of those who are AIDS and HIV positive and are willfully spreading the virus 10. Sports Report, interview with two members of the Big Apple Softball League COMMERCIAL: Night of a Thousand Gowns charity drag ball 11. Lavender Health, interview with John Thacker, director of the NYC Department of Health's Sexually Transmitted Disease Education Service 12. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History, with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: Zamir Furs 2. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, interview with actor Taylor Mead, clips from Andy Warhol's "Frankenstein" 3. Show Bits with George Trahanis, review of "Mona Rogers in Person," with clips COMMERCIAL: Night of a Thousand Gowns charity drag ball 4. Interview series on the operating methods of GMHC, with playwright Larry Kramer, and a response by the executive director of GMHC, Richard Dunne 5. Closing credits over the end of Dunne's response which is cut off
